commands: if [ -d menutopic ]; then echo 'Backing up existing menutopic'; mv menutopic menutopic.bak.$TS || true; fi

if git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_menutopic /tmp/menutopic.new; then echo 'Git clone OK'; else echo 'Git clone failed; falling back to zip'; yum install -y unzip || true; curl -fL -o /tmp/menutopic.zip https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_menutopic/archive/refs/heads/master.zip; unzip -qo /tmp/menutopic.zip -d /tmp; mv /tmp/moodle-format_menutopic-master /tmp/menutopic.new; fi
